design: genuine streaming memory: learned write-gate + soft content-addressed router + writer decide what/where to write from the text alone; the bank state resolves overwrite (gated replacement) and expiry (decay); reads go through the router; no gold markers/positions/slot at test.
gap_is: idle ticks between the last write and the query, advanced by the chosen backend at read time (SPF closed form / float iterated); the document itself is streamed sentence-by-sentence through frozen Qwen
